gloss_en: COBie export from IFC is missing 5 of the 20 standard sheets (Instruction, Impact, Coordinate, Issue, PickLists)
title_original: COBie export - missing Instruction, Impact, Coordinate, Issue, PickLists tabs
question_paraphrase: COBie spreadsheet exported from IFC (BIM Vision and Bonsai) lacks 5 of the 20 standard tabs; calls it a COBie nonconformity though the other 15 tabs have data
answer_summary: Maintainers asked who owns COBie features; discussion about which COBie version/profile the exporter implements.

gloss_en: COBie spreadsheet Systems tab is empty although Bonsai lists 214 systems
question_paraphrase: systems tab empty when exporting to COBie spreadsheet, but Bonsai's systems tab identifies 214 systems
phrasing_notes: short, factual, offers to share the IFC
answer_summary: Maintainer asked which software produced the sheet; user said Bonsai FM tab with COBie 2.4 option.

gloss_en: Error when exporting COBie, with a long log pasted
question_paraphrase: Any idea what's happening here? followed by an import-process log
phrasing_notes: one-line question then raw log, no model details

gloss_en: Python script extracting parameters to Excel works with Revit IFC exporter 22.1 but breaks with 22.6
title_original: Assistance Required for Extracting Data from IFC Files Exported with Different Versions of Revit's IFC Exporter
question_paraphrase: script reading IFC to per-file Excel works on exporter 22.1 output but data structure changed in 22.6
answer_summary: Use ifcopenshell.util.element.get_psets() instead of raw traversal.

gloss_en: Show the classification system name (not just reference) in the object information panel like Solibri
title_original: Feature Request: Enhanced Classification Display in Object Information Tab
question_paraphrase: Object Information tab shows only classification reference and name; wants the classification system shown to match Solibri
phrasing_notes: structured template: Summary, Current Behaviour, Requested Enhancement
answer_summary: Maintainer asked for a test IFC with classified objects; user supplied one.

gloss_en: Classified with Uniclass via Classification Manager (two parameters: number and description) but IFC doesn't show them as Identification and Name
question_paraphrase: Standard Data Tool creates number and description parameters; old way was 'number : description' giving Identification and Name; how to get good IFC with Classification Manager
phrasing_notes: informal, 'It doesn't work', edits post with /e
answer_summary: COBie Extension update concatenates Classification.Uniclass.EF Number and Description into COBie.Type.Category as 'Number : Description'.

gloss_en: After exporter update each Assembly Code value produces a separate IfcClassification
question_paraphrase: since latest updates export of classifications like Assembly Code is wrong, I get a different classification for each Assembly code
phrasing_notes: very short, no versions initially; commenter adds 22.5.1.0 vs 22.5.0.0
answer_summary: Commenters confirm regression in 22.5.1.0 while 22.5.0.0 worked.

gloss_en: Uniformat isn't relevant in all markets; allow Assembly Code to carry a local classification system in IFC export
title_original: ENH: Disable Uniformat classification if Assembly Code parameter is used for other classification system
question_paraphrase: Assembly Code UI is handy for any classification via custom text file but exporter assumes Uniformat
phrasing_notes: structured enhancement template with Context section
answer_summary: Maintainer states it is resolved in recent versions.

gloss_en: Export linked RVT files into a single IFC from Revit without going via Navisworks or third-party exporters
title_original: Export linked .rvt in a single IFC file
question_paraphrase: binding linked RVT loses geometry; wants a single combined IFC without Navisworks or iConstruct/Codemill
phrasing_notes: 'I know this is not a new topic' opener
answer_summary: Maintainer points to the Revit public roadmap item for IFC.

gloss_en: Is there any Pset or parameter for phasing in IFC?
question_paraphrase: Hello, is there any Pset or Parameter for IFC Phasing? Thank you in advance!
answer_summary: Replied with two YouTube videos on phasing in IFC.

gloss_en: In IDS classification facet, does a value match any level of a multi-level classification, and does URI mean IfcClassification Location or the reference location?
title_original: Classification Facet behavior is not full
question_paraphrase: value: top identification or any level? URI: which attribute?
answer_summary: Check value at any ancestor level; test case cited.

gloss_en: Require valves to have a field designation only when they have 'operational relevant = yes' (AND condition across attributes)
title_original: How to ask for two attributes in form of an "AND" condition?
question_paraphrase: only IfcValve with attribute operational relevant = yes need a field designation; IfcClass alone can't separate them
answer_summary: Put the property in applicability and the other in requirements.

gloss_en: UK BIM Framework EIR templates name the property (e.g. GrossFloorArea) but not the property set; IDS requires a Pset
title_original: How to define Property requirements in an unknown/unstated PropertySet
question_paraphrase: EIRs often name the property but not the Pset, e.g. UK BIM Framework template; IDS property facet needs both
answer_summary: Discussion on wildcard/unspecified property sets in IDS.

gloss_en: Is there a way to export parameters with empty values to IFC?
title_original: INQ: Exporting parameters with empty values
question_paraphrase: is there a way to export parameters with empty values, maybe an IFC setting switch
answer_summary: Empty parameters are not exported by design; no option today, may change.

gloss_en: ClassificationCode param leads to the same Uniclass 2015 reference assigned twice in IfcRelAssociatesClassification
title_original: Classification reference is created twice leading to invalid IFC
question_paraphrase: reference assigned twice, only with ClassificationCode parameter
answer_summary: Maintainers could not reproduce in Revit 2023-2026.

gloss_en: UK IMI Framework (BSI and nima) hub for ISO 19650 parts 1-5, PAS 1192-6, BS 8536
title_original: IMI Framework - BIM Standards, Guides & Resources
question_paraphrase: Official hub listing ISO 19650 standards by lifecycle stage, with standards, resources and FAQ sections; ukbimframework.org redirects here
answer_summary: Lists BS EN ISO 19650-1 to -5 and related documents; IFC and Uniclass not on homepage.

gloss_en: Check every element has a Uniclass 2015 Ss and Pr code
prompt: can you check all elements in the model have a Uniclass 2015 classification, Ss for systems and Pr for products. list the ones missing
expected_behavior: Read IfcRelAssociatesClassification, group by classification source, list elements/types without Uniclass Ss or Pr reference, report counts by class.

gloss_en: Check against the EIR property list before issue
prompt: EIR says all doors need FireRating, AcousticRating and Manufacturer. which ones dont have them? need before the issue tonight
expected_behavior: Find IfcDoor/types, look in Pset_DoorCommon and any pset for the properties, report missing per door with names and levels.

gloss_en: Prepare COBie Type and Component data
prompt: pull out a COBie style Type and Component list from this IFC - name, category, manufacturer, serial no, space. just spot check for now
expected_behavior: Collect types and occurrences, map to COBie columns, flag empty fields, return a table or CSV.

gloss_en: Find proxies and where they came from
prompt: loads of IfcBuildingElementProxy in this one again. how many and what revit categories? need to fix export mapping
expected_behavior: Count proxies, group by ObjectType/Revit category/family, suggest IfcExportAs mappings.

gloss_en: Check naming of storeys and spatial structure vs BEP
prompt: does the spatial structure follow our BEP? Site > Building > Storeys named L00, L01 etc. anything off?
expected_behavior: Traverse IfcSite/IfcBuilding/IfcBuildingStorey, check naming pattern and elevations, report deviations and unassigned elements.

gloss_en: Compare two issued versions
prompt: compare P02 and P03 ifc - what walls got added, deleted or changed. by GlobalId
expected_behavior: Load both models, diff IfcWall by GlobalId, list added/removed/modified (property or geometry-level where possible).

gloss_en: Extract quantities for a cost plan
prompt: need floor area by level and external wall area for the cost plan, from the Qto not calculated pls
expected_behavior: Read Qto_SlabBaseQuantities / Qto_WallBaseQuantities per storey, sum, warn where quantity sets are missing.

gloss_en: Assign Uniclass codes from a spreadsheet
prompt: I've got a spreadsheet mapping type names to Uniclass Pr codes. can you apply them to the types in the model and save a new ifc
expected_behavior: Read the mapping, create/associate IfcClassificationReference to matching types, write a new file, report unmatched types.

gloss_en: Check georeferencing for an Australian project (MGA)
prompt: is this model georeferenced to MGA zone 56? check IfcMapConversion and the CRS name, project base point looks off
expected_behavior: Read IfcMapConversion and IfcProjectedCRS, report eastings/northings/scale/rotation and whether CRS is EPSG:28356, flag inconsistencies.

gloss_en: List MEP systems and unassigned equipment
prompt: list the systems and which equipment isnt assigned to any system
expected_behavior: Read IfcSystem/IfcDistributionSystem and IfcRelAssignsToGroup, list unassigned distribution elements by type and level.

gloss_en: Rooms missing in IFC
prompt: rooms arent showing in the ifc, only some spaces. why? also areas look wrong vs the revit schedule
expected_behavior: Count IfcSpace, check room bounding/export setting hints, compare Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities areas with expected, list rooms missing.

gloss_en: Which IFC version and view to deliver
prompt: client wants IFC per ISO 19650 EIR but doesnt say which one. 2x3 coordination view or IFC4 reference view? we are on Revit 2024
expected_behavior: Explain differences, recommend asking the appropriate appointing party, suggest default (IFC4 Reference View for coordination, 2x3 CV2.0 if tools demand it), mention EIR clarification.

gloss_en: Where does the AIM/handover data come from
prompt: what do we actually need to hand over for asset info, COBie or IFC with psets? client's EIR just says 'AIM compatible'
expected_behavior: Explain AIM under ISO 19650-3, COBie as spreadsheet/IFC subset, suggest defining required properties explicitly, advise clarifying the EIR.

gloss_en: Materials and grades of structural elements
prompt: what concrete grades are on the columns and beams? give counts per grade, need to match the structural spec
expected_behavior: Read IfcMaterial assigned to IfcColumn/IfcBeam, parse grade from material or pset, tabulate counts, flag missing material.

gloss_en: Doors without host walls and duplicate elements
prompt: any doors or windows not hosted in a wall? and check for duplicate elements at the same location
expected_behavior: Check IfcRelFillsElement/IfcRelVoidsElement for doors/windows, list orphans, detect duplicates by bbox/placement.
